verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say Gitea Actions is compatible with GitHub Actions in both workflow and action syntax, so existing GitHub workflows and community actions can be reused, with actions downloadable from any Git website. The evidence is short marketing-level claims rather than in-depth compatibility documentation, and no hands-on report confirms workflows run unmodified. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of compatibility scope and unsupported features, independent or hands-on corroboration that workflows run without rewriting.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can reuse existing workflow definitions and community actions written for another platform's CI system without rewriting them

citations.quote: Gitea Actions supports CI/CD functionality, compatible with GitHub Actions. Users can write workflows in familiar YAML format and reuse a variety of existing Actions plugins.
Reuse thousands of existing GitHub Actions inside your Gitea instances.
Workflow and action syntax is compatible with GitHub Actions.
Actions plugins support downloading from any Git website.
